Enrich person.name: Ron Richardson
Enrich person.title: VP Mgr Collections MIS
Enrich person.summary: Certified Advanced SAS 9 Programmer, Certified Public Accountant (retired) & B.A., Business Administration, Hendrix College. Has extensive background in credit, economics and accounting coupled with experience in consumer banking, database design/programming and staff management/leadership. Specific areas of experience include equity & indirect lending policy, loan production decision and information systems, consumer collections information systems & application development.

experience.title: VP Mgr Collections MIS
